shared_or_similar_visual_information: A straight boundary separating the shaded and unshaded parts of a coordinate plane. Compare the diagonal line between the gray and white regions in the left image with the horizontal line between the gray and white regions in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dashed edge specifies a strict inequality, so equality points along the line are excluded. Right image: The horizontal equality boundary is included in the shaded solution region.
Rationales: The solid line in the right image admits equality. The dashed line in the left image excludes equality, even where points have been marked to locate the line.
